ios.desc:
Features you will love:
• 14 ad networks in one app
• Bar charts for your revenue
• Widgets
• Filter your revenue by app
• A list of historical revenue per network
• Details like ad requests, ad impressions, eCPM and more.

Currently the following ad networks are supported:

• AdMob
• AppLovin AppDiscovery
• AppLovin Max
• Unity LevelPlay (ironSource)
• Unity Ads
• Liftoff Monetize (Vungle)
• Mintegral
• Pangle
• InMobi
• DT Exchange
• Moloco
• Chartboost
• BidMachine
• Yandex Ads

Your API keys are stored securely in the Keychain on your device.

More coming soon!
